description:
Advances: specled.package

Review-bar-override: a gate proposal, not a defect — the class recurs across reviews and should stop being reportable.

From the critical review of specled_-n5q (Recurring class 2).

docs_identifier_lint_test is one-directional today: it rejects doc references to finding codes that do not exist in lib, but it does not verify that docs ENUMERATE every code that does. So a table claiming to list "the full set of branch-guard codes" silently goes stale the moment a code is added, and the claim becomes false with nothing failing.

This has now bitten repeatedly: docs/adoption.md full-set claim (fixed on this branch), the finding_code_budget "tenth code" total with no counting rule (fixed on this branch), and the spec-prose overclaim class generally, which is a standing review checklist item.

Making the lint bidirectional mechanizes the enumeration half permanently. The phrase-level overclaims (comparatives with no basis, "impossible" where the truth is "deferred") stay a review concern — those are not mechanizable.
title: Make docs_identifier_lint bidirectional so full-set claims cannot go stale
